description: Trending topics on X for a place, with the post volume behind each — raw material for hook writing and for judging whether a moment is worth entering. `woeid` is a Yahoo Where-On-Earth id and defaults to 1 (WORLDWIDE), so it answers without one: 23424977 United States, 23424975 United Kingdom, 23424775 Canada, 23424748 Australia. A trend X returns no volume for is reported as unknown, NEVER as zero. Needs X connected.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

name: x_trends
title: What is trending on X
